verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents many ChatGPT UI/desktop-app features (Computer Use, Browser, Canvas annotations, Voice, image generation UI, Projects, MCP in desktop app) but contains no documentation of an equivalent OpenAI/ChatGPT API surface that exposes these same capabilities programmatically; a probe for an OpenAPI spec on the docs site returned 404s, suggesting no discoverable unified API parity. Missing for 10: any docs describing API endpoints for computer-use, browser automation, image annotation/canvas, voice, or scheduled/event-triggered tasks, and any confirmation that API access mirrors UI functionality.
